question: Should this focused CI repair be rebased and landed on current main, or has subsequent main work superseded any of its four changes?
rationale: The submitted patch is coherent and proven at its head, but the protected maintainer label and dirty merge state require an explicit current-main inclusion decision.

options.title: Rebase and revalidate
options.body: Resolve the branch against current main and land the still-required changes after exact-head validation passes.

options.title: Close if superseded
options.body: Close the PR only if current-main source and validation runs prove all four repairs are already unnecessary.

recommendation.title: Rebase and revalidate
recommendation.body: Resolve the branch against current main and land the still-required changes after exact-head validation passes.
